In [[mathematics]], the '''Shimura subgroup''' Σ(''N'') is a subgroup of the Jacobian of the [[modular curve]] ''X''<sub>0</sub>(''N'') of level ''N'', given by the kernel of the natural map to the Jacobian of ''X''<sub>1</sub>(''N''). It is named after [[Goro Shimura]]. There is a similar subgroup Σ(''N'',''D'') associated to [[Shimura curve]]s of quaternion algebras.
